limitations.bounded_inspection: Installed assembly ZIPs read selectively without extracting huge case corpora. Native bundle members stream-hashed without execution/extraction. Only material/architecture evidence and package byte closures are extracted read-only. Exceeded limits halt; no evidence is omitted.
limitations.hosted_semantic_acceptance: Native execution; complete direct-core command semantics; large legacy domain semantic/reproducibility reconstruction (including subprocess-based two-runtime reference reconstruction); three original inline executable/payload/circuit comparisons and their producer payloads; browser/type gates. Every corresponding physical job and ordinary receipt remains mandatory. This audit never relabels hosted observations as local semantic replay.
limitations.no_duplicate_group_downloads: Twenty installed-group artifacts remain mandatory metadata/job gates. Their exact nested original group receipts, lifecycle logs,17 campaign receipts/logs and native ownership evidence are inspected in the four assembled artifacts already independently checked by hosted aggregate jobs. The separate twenty ZIPs are not downloaded again by this audit.
limitations.required_local_bytes: Exact59 ordinary+14unit+final receipts; both native bundles/native-suite logs/direct-group logs/base roles; four architecture SDK payloads and six-comparison receipt; both platform wheels/material companions; separate original/policy SDKs; four policy install trees; four full installed assemblies; original/policy prebuilt comparison receipts; sixteen legacy comparison receipts.
